observations: Three yellow hydraulic pallet jacks standing on a concrete floor.
The jacks have a manual hand-pull handle and a triangular base.
The brand name 'PANAMA' is visible on the side of the handle in photo 0.
The jacks appear to be in used condition with some surface wear.
A watermark 'PREYE DOUGLAS77' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The capacity rating plate is not visible in the photo.
photo 0 shows the manual handle and hydraulic lift mechanism.

risks.risk: The hydraulic pump may be leaking or seized, preventing the lift from working.
risks.proof: A video showing the jack lifting a heavy load (e.g., a 2.5-ton block) and lowering it.

risks.risk: The load-bearing capacity may be significantly lower than the 2.5-ton claim.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the stamped metal plate on the base of the jack showing the capacity rating.

risks.risk: The hydraulic seals or hoses may be worn or leaking.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the hydraulic hoses and pump area.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the stamped metal plate on the base of the jacks to confirm the capacity.
Video of the jacks lifting and lowering a heavy load.
Close-up photo of the hydraulic hoses and pump area.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
